title: Ensure 'NTLM' is set to 'Disabled'
description: This policy setting controls the use of NT Lan Manager (NTLM) v1 protocol. This protocol is used for authentication to resources. The recommended state for this setting is: Disabled. Rationale: NTLM v1 contains cryptographic weaknesses that can be easily exploited to obtain user credentials. The policy is Disabled when it is not present: the audit prints 'absent' when the list key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox\Authentication\NTLM is missing or empty, otherwise the configured entries.
reference: CIS Mozilla Firefox ESR GPO Benchmark v1.0.0 - 1.1.2.1 Ensure 'NTLM' is set to 'Disabled'

remediation.guidance: Configure through Group Policy: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Mozilla\Firefox\Authentication\NTLM = Disabled. Locally, remove the policy entries at HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox\Authentication\NTLM after reviewing them.

title: Ensure 'TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA ' is set to 'Enabled'
description: This policy settings controls the use of the TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA cipher suite. Cipher suites are a group of algorithms that help secure network connections. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled. Rationale: The Triple Data Encryption Algorithm (TDEA) also known as Triple DES (3DES) was deprecated in 2019 by NIST. 3DES is now considered an insecure cipher suite and should not be used. Audit reads the Group Policy registry value and prints 'compliant', 'unset' (policy not configured, reported as FAIL) or the non-compliant value. Registry value: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox\DisabledCiphers:TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA (REG_DWORD); compliant when it is 1. Remediation writes 1 locally; in a domain set it through the ADMX so Group Policy does not revert it.
reference: CIS Mozilla Firefox ESR GPO Benchmark v1.0.0 - 1.1.7.1 Ensure 'TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA ' is set to 'Enabled'

remediation.command: $p = 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox\DisabledCiphers'; if (-not (Test-Path -Path $p)) { New-Item -Path $p -Force | Out-Null }; New-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name 'TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
